title: 식품위생 분야 종사자의 건강진단 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Conducting Health Examinations) Health examinations under these Rules shall be conducted at public health centers under the Regional Public Health Act (hereinafter referred to as "public health centers") or general hospitals, hospitals, or clinics under the Medical Service Act (hereinafter referred to as "medical institutions"): Provided, That where a business operator requests an examination, a medical professional at a medical institution may visit the business establishment and conduct the health examination. <Amended on December 31, 2018>
